expected_behavior_change: Admin V3 can persist a formal server Draft separately from unsaved browser edits.
Saved Draft supports authoritative reload/new-browser restoration and optimistic concurrency.
Stale Draft or stale second-tab writes fail closed with explicit conflicts.
Publish-from-Draft reuses existing Admin publish authority and clears Draft only after successful canonical publish.
Final canonical base guard prevents stale Draft overwrite during a publish race.
non_goals: No Pricing authority or takeaway surcharge schema change.
No Order, Payment, Refund, Cancel or provider transaction change.
No localStorage, sessionStorage or Dexie formal Draft authority.
No production deploy, hostname cutover or OTA.
